statements.subject: server
statements.description: When normal (2yz or 551) responses are returned from a VRFY or EXPN request, the reply MUST include the <Mailbox> name using a "<local-part@domain>" construction.
statements.trigger: VRFY or EXPN command received with normal response

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Since they were both optional in RFC 821, but VRFY was made mandatory in RFC 1123, if EXPN is supported, it MUST be listed as a service extension in an EHLO response.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: For security reasons, implementations MAY provide local installations a way to disable either or both of these commands (VRFY, EXPN) through configuration options or the equivalent.
statements.trigger: VRFY or EXPN command received while command is disabled
actions: refuse or reject VRFY or EXPN command

statements.subject: server
statements.description: VRFY MAY be listed as a convenience but, since support for it is required, SMTP clients are not required to check for its presence on the extension list before using it.
actions: client may send VRFY without checking EHLO extension list
